stack.about.title: About
stack.about.p1: I am Stephane Vellement, a full-stack developer with more than 25 years of experience. I run an EURL based in the Pays de la Loire region of France. My work focuses on digital sovereignty, sovereign LLM deployments, agentic RAG, and container infrastructure with Docker and Traefik.
stack.about.p2: I help teams move sensitive workloads off US hyperscalers without losing delivery speed. This repository collects the guides, checklists and tools I use and refine on real projects.
stack.stack.title: Current Stack
stack.stack.desc: The tools I run in production today, grouped by layer.
stack.conv.title: Engineering Convictions
stack.conv.desc: A few principles that guide the technical choices on client work.
stack.conv.1.t: Digital sovereignty in professional and sensitive contexts
stack.conv.1.b: When a client handles regulated or public sector data, that data stays inside infrastructure we control. Sovereignty is a requirement here, not a marketing word.
stack.conv.2.t: Self-hosted by default for GDPR or public clients
stack.conv.2.b: For projects under GDPR, or with public sector clients, self-hosted is the default choice. A managed third-party service is an exception that has to be justified.
stack.conv.3.t: LLM in the EU rather than US hyperscalers for client data
stack.conv.3.b: Client data goes to models hosted in the EU (Mistral, or Ollama on our own servers). US hyperscaler APIs are avoided for anything that carries client information.
stack.conv.4.b: On personal projects I stay pragmatic. The rules above exist to protect client data, they are not a dogma applied to everything.
